purpose: Teach: 盛り込ん/伺う/留保/派生/量産/保留/激減/差し上げ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さんの代から、創業精神を、盛り込んだ社是、今も、生きているな。
lines.en: Since your father's time, the founding spirit embedded in our company motto—it's still very much alive.
lines.style: Measured, reflective opening. Voice settles deeper. Unhurried, with the weight of decades behind each phrase. A gentle nod in the voice at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。来月、創業者の墓所を、お伺うつもりです、社員代表として。
lines.en: Yes. Next month I'm planning to visit the founder's grave as the company's representative.
lines.style: Direct but warm. Respectful cadence. Slight emphasis on the responsibility—not boastful, but grounded in duty. Clear and composed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業期、私も、しばらく、判断を、留保したこと、何度もあった。
lines.en: In those early days, I myself held back from making decisions more times than I can count.
lines.style: Quiet, almost confessional. A pause before 'held back'—he's remembering. Softer in the middle. The voice carries a hint of wry recognition, not regret.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。創業時の事業から、派生した、新事業、私の代でも、進めております。
lines.en: Yes. The new projects that grew out of those original ventures—we're still developing them, even in my time.
lines.style: Steady, measured. A sense of continuation, not pride. Emphasis on 'still developing'—showing respect for the ongoing work. Professional but genuine.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 量産体制の確立、創業期の私たちの、夢だったな、本当に、頑張った。
lines.en: Building the mass-production system—that was our real dream in those founding years. We worked incredibly hard for it.
lines.style: Warmth beneath the recollection. A small smile in the voice. 'Worked incredibly hard' rises slightly with earned satisfaction, then softens. Memory made tangible.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんが、保留されていた案件、今、進められそうです、ようやく。
lines.en: Yes. The projects your father had put on hold—we're finally in a position to move forward with them.
lines.style: Thoughtful, with gentle recognition of patience rewarded. 'Finally' carries no frustration, just clarity. Respectful of the elder's original vision.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業期の業績、激減した時期、乗り越えた経験、今に、活きている。
lines.en: When we faced that steep decline in the founding era, the experience of weathering it—that's what sustains us now.
lines.style: Grave but not heavy. A statement of fact delivered with quiet certainty. The voice touches the hardship lightly, then grounds it in present resilience.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。創業者として、お父さんに、感謝状、差し上げる予定です、創業祭で。
lines.en: Yes. I'm planning to present a letter of thanks to you at the founding anniversary celebration—to honor you as the founder.
lines.style: Formal but deeply felt. A slight rise on 'letter of thanks'—this moment carries weight. Steady, clear, with genuine emotion held in careful composure.
